column1: # Cases in cases.tsv where a front end disagrees with the CLI, found by
# `differential.py compare` on macos-15, where every front end builds against
# libc++. Each line names the front end (the run directory: python, r or js),
# what differs (see README.md), and the issue that tracks it. The check fails
# on a disagreement that is not listed and on a listed one that no longer
# shows, so fixing the issue means removing its lines here.
